title: ticfac watch still replays an earlier incarnation's terminal line
description: Found by tick 55i (run epic-9pd, attempt 2). 55i fixed events --follow with a from-now cursor. ticfac watch, added by tick 0z0 in the same run, still calls runfeed.Follow from offset zero: a watch started on a resumed run reads the previous incarnation's run_finished first, exits at once, and reports a failure that already happened. It is the defect 55i describes, in the command built to be alerted by it. Same fix shape (follow from the end), and its run_held semantics need deciding: whether a watch started while a run is already holding should report the hold it joined.
notes: 2026-09-18 08:30 - ticfac run epic-9pd: attempt 29 reported a finding drafted for triage — defect "internal/reconcile/restart_test.go is not gofmt-formatted at the base commit" (key 5437a241413d3fa46cee7562be666ed32d6ea57e64d22cdbc4eeced1593d8d9f, severity low, for this repository). Triage with `ticfac finding 9pd 5437a241413d3fa46cee7562be666ed32d6ea57e64d22cdbc4eeced1593d8d9f --promote-as <tick> --by "<who>"`, `--discard --by "<who>"`, or — when it was repaired inside this epic — `--fixed-as <commit> --by "<who>"`; the tick cannot close while it is untriaged.
acceptance_criteria: A watch started on a resumed run does not exit on a previous incarnation's terminal line, and a watch started while the run holds an attempt reports that hold; both proven by tests
